The summit of Mount Everest is at 8,849 m. The shore of the Dead Sea is at about −430 m. What is the difference in height?
Explain, using a number line or a real-life example, why 5 − (−3) = 8.
questions.modelAnswer: Subtracting means finding the difference, or taking something away. Taking away a debt of 3 is like gaining 3, so 5 − (−3) = 5 + 3 = 8. On a number line, the distance from −3 to 5 is 8 steps, so 5 − (−3) = 8.
